---
title: Write a guide: Git and GitHub for your portfolio
labels: content
---

**Why.** Phase 4 depends on a public portfolio, and the 90-day plan has learners create a GitHub repository on days 46 and 47. No page explains how.

**Outline.**
1. Create an account and a first repository.
2. `git init`, `add`, `commit`, `push`, and writing a useful commit message.
3. A good `README.md` for a project.
4. Repository layout for write-ups.
5. What never to commit: passwords, keys, tokens, real personal data, answers for live competitions. Include `.gitignore` and what to do after a leaked secret.
6. Optional: a portfolio page with GitHub Pages.

**Add to.** `guides/`, linked from `roadmap/02-hands-on.md`, `roadmap/04-get-hired.md` and `guides/study-plan-90-days.md`.

**Done when.** A learner with no Git experience can publish a write-up.
